# Docs Freeze status

Comment on each tracked KEP issue a few days after Code Freeze, once the Code
Freeze exceptions have been handled. Check the boxes that apply and set the
status on the Release Tracking Board to match.

```text
Hello KEP owners! <future release> Docs team here.

As we approach:
- Docs PRs ready for review deadline: <date>
- Docs Freeze deadline: <date>

Here's where this enhancement currently stands:
- [ ] The docs PR(s) in the `k/website` repo related to your enhancement are linked in the issue description above (for tracking purposes).
- [ ] The docs PR(s) target the `dev-<future release>` branch.
- [ ] The docs PR(s) are ready for review: they contain all the required changes and are marked ready for review.
- [ ] The docs PR(s) are ready to be merged (they have the `approved` and `lgtm` labels) by the Docs Freeze deadline.

The status of this enhancement is marked as <At risk for docs freeze | Tracked for docs freeze>.

If you anticipate missing Docs Freeze, you can file an [exception request](https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/blob/master/releases/EXCEPTIONS.md) in advance.
```
